items.name: Geometry and measurement
items.basis: [strict: 1 -> 2] Executed headless primitives now have saved/reopened output evidence. P01: line/circle/arc/closed polyline/ellipse/MTEXT created through the entity tool, saved, and read back with ezdxf with matching coordinates, radius, angles, ratio and layer. P08: hatch on a closed rectangle reopens with one 4-vertex ANSI31 boundary.
items.scope_and_limits: No length/area/topology measurement exists (P03: unknown operation). Boundary failures: create_circle radius=-5 and create_polyline with zero points return ok=true and the invalid entities are saved (P13). entity get returns no geometry for ARC (P02) and reports the raw OCS center [-100, 0] for a mirrored circle whose true WCS center is [100, 0] (probe_mirror_readback.json), so tool readback can misreport geometry. Hatch on a circle fails and leaves an empty HATCH (D-C1b). File IPC/AutoCAD LT paths were not executed (Windows/AutoCAD only) and stay at first-pass source evidence.

deduction.reason: Withhold 3: ordinary path works, but invalid input is accepted, readback misreports mirrored geometry and measurement is absent, so 3 is not met.

items.name: Editing
items.basis: [strict: 1 -> 2] Executed transforms now have saved/reopened output evidence; a destructive partial write was reproduced. P04 + probe_mirror.py: move, rotate, scale, copy, array (2x3 -> 5 copies) and mirror (circle/line/arc, verified in WCS) produce the requested geometry after save and reopen. Bad handles are refused (P13); offset/fillet/chamfer are refused honestly on ezdxf (P05).
items.scope_and_limits: Reproduced D-C1a: a mirror call with a zero-length line returns ok=false but leaves a stray copy in the drawing and in the saved DXF (entities 1 -> 2). array rows=0/cols=0 returns ok with 0 copies; scale factor 0 is refused only by an internal 'float division' error. No trim/join. P04 initially showed mirror as FAIL; that was a probe error (OCS vs WCS) and probe_mirror.py confirms the mirror geometry is correct. File IPC/AutoCAD LT paths were not executed (Windows/AutoCAD only) and stay at first-pass source evidence.

deduction.reason: Withhold 3: capped at 2 by the reproduced destructive partial write on a refused mirror call.

items.name: Annotation and styles
items.basis: [strict: 1 -> 2] Executed dimensions/text/leader now have saved/reopened output evidence. P09: linear, aligned, angular and radius dimensions are saved as DIMENSION entities whose rendered blocks display 42,5 / 50 / 90 deg / R12, matching the geometry; TEXT and LEADER(+MTEXT) are saved. radius=0 is refused (P10).
items.scope_and_limits: Dimension calls return no handle, so they cannot be addressed later. The linear dimension displays '42,5' (comma decimal separator from ezdxf's default style) for 42.5; no style control exists to change it. No text/dimension styles, tolerances or fits; radius=0 refused only via an internal 'float division' message. IPC dimension handlers return ok unconditionally (source). File IPC/AutoCAD LT paths were not executed (Windows/AutoCAD only) and stay at first-pass source evidence.

deduction.reason: Withhold 3: ordinary path works; styles, tolerances/fits and addressable dimensions are absent and error handling is incidental.

items.name: Organization and exchange
items.basis: [strict: 1 -> 2] Executed layer/block/save paths now have output evidence; omitted-edit false success reproduced headless. P11: layer color, freeze, lock and linetype persist after save/reopen; set_current on a missing layer is refused. P12: block define with ATTDEF, insert_with_attributes, get_attributes and update_attribute persist (TAG=V-202 after reopen); a missing tag and a missing block are refused.
items.scope_and_limits: Reproduced false successes: layer set_properties with lineweight=50 returns ok but the lineweight is not saved (P11); insert_with_attributes with a tag the block does not define returns ok and silently drops it (saved attribs {'TAG': ''}, P12). A duplicate block define surfaces a raw ezdxf error with an AutoCAD-oriented hint. No paper space, viewports, tables; PDF plot is refused on ezdxf. The IPC insert_with_attributes defect (attributes never applied) is source-only. File IPC/AutoCAD LT paths were not executed (Windows/AutoCAD only) and stay at first-pass source evidence.

deduction.reason: Withhold 3: capped at 2 by reproduced omitted-edit false successes (lineweight, undefined attribute tag).

items.scope_and_limits: insert_valve with rotation=45 and attributes={'TAG': 'V-1'} returns ok, but the saved diamond is unrotated and no attribute is stored; list_symbols for an unknown category returns ok with an empty list. The README states the ezdxf backend 'has built-in CTO library support'. IPC P&ID needs the uncommitted pid_tools.lsp. No other domain workflow. File IPC/AutoCAD LT paths were not executed (Windows/AutoCAD only) and stay at first-pass source evidence.

items.name: Foreign and abnormal inputs
items.basis: [strict: 1 -> 2] Executed abnormal-input probes. P13: open of a missing file and of a truncated DXF return ok=false (DXFStructureError); bad handles for get/move/erase and unknown operations are refused; missing required keys are caught by _safe.

declared_contract: MCP stdio server (v3.0.0 in pyproject, v3.1 in README/server) exposing 8 consolidated tools (drawing, entity, layer, block, annotation, pid, view, system) for AutoCAD LT 2024+ automation and headless DXF generation. Two backends: File IPC (Windows; Python writes JSON command files to C:/temp and posts '(c:mcp-dispatch)' keystrokes to AutoCAD LT, where mcp_dispatch.lsp runs AutoCAD commands and writes result files) and ezdxf (any platform, in-memory DXF, matplotlib screenshots). Declared scope: 2D primitives, basic transforms, layers, blocks/attributes, text/dimensions/leaders, P&ID symbols from the third-party CTO library, save/DXF/PDF, undo/redo and arbitrary AutoLISP via execute_lisp (File IPC).

serious_defects.description: File IPC create/copy/mirror/offset/hatch report the (entlast) handle without checking that a new entity was created.
ezdxf purge returns purged=true but removes nothing; entity get reports a mirrored circle's OCS center (-100,0) as its center while the true position is (100,0).
File IPC drawing-save, save-as-dxf, open and plot-pdf return ok=true unconditionally.
ezdxf entity_mirror leaves a stray copy when it rejects a zero-length mirror line, and create_hatch leaves an empty HATCH when the boundary lookup fails; both persist in the saved DXF.
execute_lisp (arbitrary AutoLISP, SECURELOAD set to 0 while loading) is default-enabled in the 'system' tool advertised readOnlyHint=true; drawing.save overwrites arbitrary existing files.
serious_defects.reproduction: annotation and unrestricted overwrite reproduced over stdio/tool calls; LISP execution not executable here
